Visible bevels. Albedo has no baked lighting and is slightly more saturated than a photo. No cel-shade, no generic asset-pack costume, no thin-limb hitboxes. Liquid polymer with a hard skin, chrome flecks, nebula pink only inside the gap.
entries.silhouette_notes: Must read as a pure-black silhouette at 100m and at chase-camera distance. Windup / strike / recover poses stay distinct. A ring that will not close, standing on three thick legs of polymer. The gap in the ring is the face.

unity_bind.spawner: EvoSpawner biome weight; RoadWorld fauna list if canon_kind set
unity_bind.mesh_policy: Dedicated Concordia mesh. Do not satisfy this id with a Quaternius or Kenney rename (no wolf→Fox, no griffin→Horse, no sealie→Flamingo, no harpy→Parrot). CX humanoid is not a fauna body. Clips may retarget later; the mesh is native.

entries.aura_prompt: Orthographic turnaround plus one hero pose, pure-black silhouette inset. Stylized realism, GTA wear, Palworld readable mass, saturated light, visible bevels, PBR albedo without baked light. Standing open ring on three thick polymer legs, the gap is the face, chrome flecks, pink only inside the gap, Crucible.

stats_hooks.rewind: below 20% HP it rewinds once unless skill_craft_lattice_unend or skill_presence is ranked to force completion

weak_points.hint: the face
a broken leg prevents the rewind stance

entries.boss_rule: Walking out of the arena stamps WorldEventLog 'refused completion' and counts as a win for faction Crucible lattice. It does not drop the fragment.

entries.lore_blurb: Sere delve boss. The only law that compounds. A furnace brute wearing every unpaid brand at once. It does not negotiate; the Tessera do, afterward.
entries.art_style_notes: Stylized realism PBR: GTA micro-wear (scratches, peel, stain, edge dirt) on a Palworld-readable silhouette (bold mass, saturated key light, one emissive accent). Visible bevels. Albedo has no baked lighting and is slightly more saturated than a photo. No cel-shade, no generic asset-pack costume, no thin-limb hitboxes. Soot brick, oil, cracked tiles. Fire stays in the chimney eye and the mouth of the furnace, not as a full-body aura.
entries.silhouette_notes: Must read as a pure-black silhouette at 100m and at chase-camera distance. Windup / strike / recover poses stay distinct. Kiln-shaped torso, brand tiles as a skirt of iron, head a chimney with one eye of fire. The eye is the only emissive.

entries.audio_tell: Bellows. The bill-call is a stamp.
entries.boss_rule: Witness heat on Sere factions rises if you loot the body in front of a Tessera. skill_presence_name_the_holder names a debtor and redirects the next slam.

entries.lore_blurb: The per-spoke watcher from RoadWorld. One family, eight culture skins. It stands the gate road and does not chase into the Hub plaza. Humanoid so it can share CX proportions without replacing the CX face: the face is a mask, the body is a kitbash of that world's guard role.
entries.art_style_notes: Stylized realism PBR: GTA micro-wear (scratches, peel, stain, edge dirt) on a Palworld-readable silhouette (bold mass, saturated key light, one emissive accent). Visible bevels. Albedo has no baked lighting and is slightly more saturated than a photo. No cel-shade, no generic asset-pack costume, no thin-limb hitboxes. GTA wear on the coat, one saturated accent from the world palette. Mask is beaten metal or carved wood or acrylic depending on skin.
entries.silhouette_notes: Must read as a pure-black silhouette at 100m and at chase-camera distance. Windup / strike / recover poses stay distinct. Same pose language everywhere: feet planted, weapon low, mask with no mouth. Culture is told by the weapon and the coat, not by a new body.
